benchmark_targets.name: Barnard's Star
benchmark_targets.description: Fastest proper motion star known (10.36"/yr). M4.0V red dwarf located 5.96 light-years from Earth. Ideal benchmark for cross-epoch blink comparison and dipole signature detection in SPHEREx multi-epoch surveys.

benchmark_targets.name: WISE 0855-0714
benchmark_targets.description: Sub-stellar Y2 brown dwarf with effective temperature ~250 K (below freezing). Fourth closest stellar/substellar system to the Sun. Exhibits strong atmospheric water ice clouds and methane absorption across SPHEREx bands, invisible in optical Gaia surveys.

benchmark_targets.name: Epsilon Indi B
benchmark_targets.description: Benchmark binary brown dwarf system (T1V + T6V) in orbit around K-dwarf Epsilon Indi A. High proper motion (4.70"/yr) makes it a prime calibration standard for high-contrast infrared difference imaging.

benchmark_targets.name: RW Aurigae
benchmark_targets.description: Classical T Tauri pre-main-sequence binary undergoing dramatic multi-magnitude dimming episodes caused by tidal disruption and circumstellar dust stream occultations. Benchmark for flux variability without high astrometric shift.

benchmark_targets.name: R Draconis
benchmark_targets.description: High-amplitude Mira-type pulsating red giant with a characteristic ~245-day cycle. In SPHEREx 6-month survey cadences, R Draconis transitions between peak infrared emission and deep minima, producing prominent single-epoch difference residuals.
